title: Turkish Gerundial Clauses (-ken / -ince)
explanation: Attach '-ken' (or '-ince/-ınca') to verb stems or nouns to mean 'while doing something' or 'when something happened'.

example_translations.ex_trken_1: I bought bread while coming home.

common_error_explanations.err_trken_1: Use suffix '-ken' directly to express simultaneous actions.
